name: Magazine Cover
blurb: A glossy fashion-magazine cover: the B-roll is the cover photo, a huge serif masthead sits behind it, and every line adds a cover line in the corners (key words in the accent colour); on the turn the page turns to the next issue with a new cover shot; a barcode and an 'EXCLUSIVE' badge; the title becomes the cover story.
off_why: s25 ultra 2026-10-23: a narrow portrait cover on a beige backdrop, 'white bars on the side ... we make 16:9 landscape videos, never an intro that narrow again'
